description: This file defines culture-specific data for Arabic (Qatar) date and time formatting, including names of days and months, date patterns, regex patterns for parsing dates, and prototype extensions for date objects.

methods.name: clearTime
methods.description: Resets a date object to the start of the day by setting hours, minutes, seconds, and milliseconds to zero.

methods.name: setTimeToNow
methods.description: Sets the time of the date object to the current local time.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a new copy of the date object.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares the date object with another date, returning -1, 0, or 1.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks if two dates are equal.
